Use when the user wants to display information on their TRMNL device, send messages to an e-ink display, create dashboard content, show notifications, or update their terminal display. Supports rich layouts with the TRMNL framework (flexbox, grid, tables, progress bars, typography utilities).
skills.description_zh: 使用TRMNL CSS框架为TRMNL电子墨水屏生成内容并通过CLI发送。适用于在设备上显示信息、发送消息、创建仪表盘、显示通知或更新终端。支持丰富的布局（弹性布局、网格、表格、进度条及排版工具）。
skills.name: TRMNL Display
